Lina (solutions): Hey team, ACME's security questionnaire just came back. Q: do traces or logs ever contain raw user PII (emails, ssn)? They want a short answer for the SOC review.
Jared (sales): They're asking for a yes/no + where they can see the controls.
Priya (infra): Short answer: not by default. Our SDKs redact common PII fields and we provide header-based opt-out/in for richer context. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/redaction.
Lina (solutions): Can you paste the redaction config snippet I can give them?
Priya (infra): Sure: 

  REDWOOD_REDACT_FIELDS=email,ssn,credit_card
  REDWOOD_REDACT_MODE=strict

Also we mask emails in span.attributes unless TRACE_PII_INJECTION=true is set at the runtime.
Jared (sales): ACME will want an assurance this doesn't affect correlation (trace_id still present). They asked if masking can break trace/span join.
Priya (infra): Masking only runs on payload/attributes. Trace headers (x-trace-id / traceparent) are kept intact for correlation. The only way we'd lose it is if their sidecar/proxy strips headers.
Lina (solutions): Speaking of sidecars, during the POC we saw some traces missing trace parent and only request_id in logs. Different from earlier thread. Any idea?
Priya (infra): Yep, we've seen a kube-inject sidecar that overwrites headers when doing TLS termination. Quick checklist: 1) confirm header exists at client -> LB, 2) check sidecar env STRIP_HEADERS, 3) ensure proxy preserves traceparent.
Jared (sales): Customer says they can't change sidecar config. Any workaround?
Priya (infra): Temporary workaround: synthesize trace id in the forwarder pipeline if header missing. Example ingest rule (vector/fluentd): 

  if not event["trace_id"] and event["request_id"] then
    event["trace_id"] = event["request_id"]
  end

Not ideal for full distributed traces but lets dashboards correlate for POC.
Lina (solutions): Also they want to know about GDPR: retention of IDs. Can we redact old traces on request?
Priya (infra): We support deletion via API for hosted customers. For Dedicated, we provide scripts and can help with purge in the POC. Governance note: deletion removes events from our indexing layer; backups may persist per customer retention policy.
Jared (sales): Another operational note: we hit sporadic 429s on the ingest forwarder and the customer flagged missing spans at those times. Could the rate limit cause partial traces?
Priya (infra): Yes. If span events are dropped you get orphaned request logs without their child spans. We recommend increasing HEC throughput or enabling buffering on the forwarder. Add these envs: 

  FORWARDER_BUFFER_BYTES=104857600
  FORWARDER_RETRIES=5

And monitor via ingest-bot.
ingest-bot: alert: forwarder.hec.acme.com 429 spike detected 2026-03-20T22:58Z -> 30m (avg 7/min)
Lina (solutions): ACME asked if we can add an audit statement confirming redaction was active during POC. Can we provide a signed statement?
Priya (infra): We can produce a POC audit log: config snapshot + deploy timestamps + redaction envs. I'll attach to the ticket.
QA-bot: note: run header-echo test after any config change: 

  curl -H "x-trace-id: poc-P-123" -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/debug/header-echo

Expect response JSON.trace_headers includes x-trace-id.
Jared (sales): Change window is tomorrow 17:00 PST. Customer ok to apply forwarder buffer and add a synthetic rule if needed.
Priya (infra): I'll prepare a small playbook: 
  - verify header passthrough at LB
  - check sidecar STRIP_HEADERS
  - apply FORWARDER_BUFFER_BYTES & retries
  - deploy synth-trace transform if headers absent
  - run QA-bot test and search Splunk index for sample trace id

Deploy-bot: release/poc-acme-forwarder-playbook rolled at 2026-03-22T17:02:00Z
Lina (solutions): Thanks. I'll update the SOC response: "Traces do not contain user PII by default; redaction enabled and trace headers preserved for correlation; playbook attached for POC changes."
Jared (sales): Customer happy with that language. Closing this thread unless anything else crops up.
Priya (infra): I'll follow-up with the config snapshot in the ticket.
Lina (solutions): Closing. :white_check_mark:
